name: color_scheme
title: Color Scheme
description: A light, dark or system theme switcher that remembers the choice in localStorage.

classes.name: icon--color-scheme-light
classes.description: Shown only when the light scheme is active.

classes.name: icon--color-scheme-dark
classes.description: Shown only when the dark scheme is active.

attributes.name: data-color-scheme
attributes.description: The controller root. Its value is set to light, dark or system, and CSS sets color-scheme from it.

actions.name: setLight
actions.description: Uses the light scheme and saves the choice.

actions.name: setDark
actions.description: Uses the dark scheme and saves the choice.

actions.name: setSystem
actions.description: Follows the operating system setting and saves the choice.

events.name: velle:color-scheme:change
events.description: Dispatched after the scheme changes. event.detail.colorScheme holds the new value.

notes: The choice is stored in localStorage under the key "color_scheme".
All colors are defined with light-dark(), so switching color-scheme is all a theme change needs.

To avoid a flash of the wrong theme, set the attribute before the page paints with an inline script in <head>: <script>document.documentElement.dataset.colorScheme = localStorage.getItem("color_scheme") || "system"</script>

examples.title: Theme switcher
examples.description: This page's own <html> element is the root, so the switcher changes the whole docs site.
